_comment: STUB of the camayoc stored query bobbin's memory mirror consumes (aegis-gshu.2). The real per-entity recall queries are built by aegis-gshu.10 in camayoc; replace this stub when they land. Interface: see src/memory_recall.rs module docs. The stub reads the body from rdfs:comment; camayoc maps each entity's own field (chose, rule, prefers, lesson, ...) to body. quipu's SPARQL engine leaves IF/COALESCE results unbound, so status and cursor come from a UNION of a current branch and a superseded branch.
name: mem_index_since
description: Memory records changed since a cursor: current ones to upsert, superseded ones to delete. Ordered by cursor; 50 rows plus one overflow sentinel.

params.name: since
params.description: Opaque cursor from the last row of the previous page; empty for a full pull.
